name: uberasm-bonus-game-death-fix
title: Bonus Game Death Fix
description:
In vanilla SMW, dying in the level 000/100 bonus game will teleport the player back to the overworld and require them to re-play the level. It'll also reduce their lives counter and consume the 100 bonus stars needed to enter the bonus game.

With this (albeit simple) UberASM code, dying in a bonus game will not decrease the lives counter, but will simply teleport them back to the overworld and trigger events -- paying respect to the fact that they completed the actual level.
It will also play the "Bonus Game End" jingle.

Note that this is intended to be used in "bonus game" rooms only -- as in, the bonus game room entered after collecting 100 bonus stars.
